lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots spaced approximately equidistant from one another, forming a rectangular grid pattern on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity that intersect with the center of the circular spots, creating a lattice-like visual structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A horizontal feature showing a distinct vertical luminance gradient (light above, dark below) extending from the post-cranial region through the mid-section of the flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density arrangement of small, high-luminance pixel clusters distributed across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: A significant transition in spot morphology occurs anterior to the gill slits, where larger grid-aligned blobs are replaced by a high-density population of much smaller, randomly distributed high-luminance points.
